# Fact sheet: land and railway rules used by the screening

> **Not legal advice.** A short, sourced summary prepared for a personal portfolio project. It states what
> the cited public documents say, checked on 2026-11-24; it is not a statement of the law as it applies to
> any land, and it says nothing about how any agency handles cases internally.

<!-- Generated by scripts/build_docs.py from inputs/facts.yaml. Edit that file, not this page. -->

**How to read it.** *VERIFIED*: the quoted words were found in the cited document. For statutes, Singapore
Statutes Online (SSO) refused automated access (HTTP 403 on its Terms of Use page), so no further automated
request was sent to SSO and no bot challenge was attempted; statutory text was read instead from
SSO-generated "informal consolidation" PDFs held by FAOLEX (FAO), whose in-force dates are given.
*UNVERIFIED*: the document could not be read; the row is a pointer only. Quotes are short extracts for
checking; copyright stays with the publishers. Web addresses are given as plain-text citations rather than
links, because several publishers' website terms ask for permission before linking.

33 of 36 rows are VERIFIED and 3 UNVERIFIED. Rows marked *used* feed a calculation in
the screening (`corridor.config.fact_value()` refuses UNVERIFIED rows).

## Compensation

| ID | Claim | Source | Where | Quote | Status |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| F04 | For land acquired on or after 12 February 2007, compensation starts from the market value as at the date of the s.3(1) notification (if a s.5 declaration follows within 6 months) or otherwise as at the date of the s.5 declaration, with other listed heads such as severance, injurious affection and relocation expenses. | L1c | s.33(1)(a)-(f) | "where the date of acquisition of the land is on or after 12 February 2007, the market value of the acquired land" | VERIFIED<br>as F01 |
| F05 | Market value is capped at what a bona fide purchaser would pay given the zoning and density under the Planning Act at the date of acquisition; potential value for a more intensive use is ignored. | L1c | s.33(5)(e) | "no account is to be taken of any potential value of the land for any other use more intensive than that permitted" | VERIFIED<br>as F01 |

| F23 | A declaration may cover only part of the airspace above, or of the subterranean space below, a piece of land. | L1c | s.5(1A) | "only so much of subterranean space below the surface of any land, is needed" | VERIFIED<br>as F01 |
| F24 | Where only subterranean space is acquired, compensation is based on the market value of that space plus the other listed heads. | L1c | s.33(1A) | "the market value of the airspace or subterranean space acquired" | VERIFIED<br>as F01 |
| F25 | Under the Act "land" includes airspace and subterranean space; subterranean space is the subsoil below the surface. | L1c | s.2(1) | "“subterranean space” means the subsoil below the surface of the earth" | VERIFIED<br>as F01 |
| F26 | MinLaw explained that strata acquisition lets the Government take only the stratum a public project needs instead of the whole column of land. | M3 | Allowing Flexibility to Acquire Specific Stratum of Space | "instead of having to acquire the entire column of land, including the surface land and airspace" | VERIFIED<br>speech text |
